# LinkedIn Marketing API Program

The LinkedIn Marketing Platform helps businesses grow by building technology to reach, engage, and convert professional audiences at scale. The platform offers APIs to create LinkedIn marketing campaigns, to report campaign performance, to manage leads, and to grow a company Page.

## LinkedIn Marketing APIs

### Advertising

With Advertising APIs, streamline your campaign management, audience targeting, and track performance to optimize advertising efforts.

*   [Campaign Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/getting-started?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements - Advertising API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/integration-requirements?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Reporting and Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads-reporting/getting-started?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements - Reporting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads-reporting/integration-requirements-reporting?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Event Management

Streamline event operations, amplify visibility, and drive meaningful connections within the professional landscape with Events APIs (Management & Ads).

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/event-management/event-management-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Events](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/event-management/events?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Event Management API Usecases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/event-management/event-management-usecase?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/event-management/integration-requirements-event-management?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Community Management

Efficiently manage and engage with their LinkedIn communities, enhancing social media presence and interactions on the platform.

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/community-management-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Page Access Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Page and Content Analysis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/follower-statistics?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Shares & Social Stream](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Monitor Mentions of Your Brand](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/organization-social-action-notifications?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Mention a Member or a Brand](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/posts-atmention-search-api?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/integration-requirements-community-management?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Lead Sync

Seamlessly synchronize lead data captured through LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms with customer relationship management (CRM) systems and simplify lead management and follow-up processes.

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/lead-sync/leadsync-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Lead Sync](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/lead-sync/leadsync?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Lead Sync API Use Cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/lead-sync/lead-sync-usecase?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/lead-sync/marketing-leads-integration-requirements?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Matched Audiences

Reach specific audiences by uploading contact lists, website retargeting, or utilizing account targeting for more precise Ad campaigns on the platform.

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/matched-audiences?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [DMP Segments](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/create-and-manage-segments?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [DMP Segment Users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/create-and-manage-segment-users?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [DMP Segment Destinations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/create-and-manage-segment-destinations?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [DMP Segment Companies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/create-and-manage-segment-companies?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [DMP Segment List](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/create-and-manage-list-uploads?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Website Retargeting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/website-visitors-retargeting?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Ad Segments](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/adsegments?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Predictive Audiences](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/predictive-audiences?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Matched Audiences API Use Cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/matched-audiences-usecase?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/matched-audiences/integration-requirements?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Audience Insights

Provides valuable data and analytics to advertisers, helping you better understand and target your audience on the platform for more effective and tailored marketing campaigns.

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/advertising-targeting/audience-insights-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Audience Insights API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/advertising-targeting/audience-insights-api?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Audience Insights API Use Cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/advertising-targeting/audience-insights-usecase?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/advertising-targeting/integration-requirements-audience-insights?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Media Planning

Enables marketers to have a better understanding of investment delivery against valuable audiences and objectives

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/media-planning/media-planning-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Media Planning API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/media-planning/media-planning-api?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Manage Media Plans](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/media-planning/media-plan?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Media Planning API Use Cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/media-planning/media-planning-usecase?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/media-planning/integration-requirements-media-planning?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Conversions

Securely and accurately track and measure the impact of their LinkedIn ad campaigns by sending conversion event data directly to LinkedIn, to help optimize your advertising efforts.

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/conversions-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Conversions API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads-reporting/conversions-api?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Getting Access to Conversions API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/getting-access-conversions?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Deduplication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/deduplication?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Enabling Click IDs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/enabling-first-party-cookies?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Google Tag Manager Server-Side Tagging](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/conversions-api-gtm-guide?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Conversions API Payload Builder](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/conversions-payload-builder?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Use Cases - Conversions API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/conversions-usecase?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Integration Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/conversions/integration-requirements-conversions?view=li-lms-2026-11) 

### Company Intelligence

Gain insights into company level data for all companies reached via LinkedIn with engagement score, paid impressions, paid clicks, leads, organic impressions, and organic engagements.

*   [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/account-intel/company-intelligence-overview?view=li-lms-2026-11) 
*   [Company Intelligence API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/account-intel/account-intel-api?view=li-lms-2026-11)
